description: Board-fabricated 1.5 mm through-hole prototyping pad on a 0.1 inch (2.54 mm) grid. It is not a purchasable component: pad 1 is a bare plated hole the user wires by hand, and the field is a grid of these pads. The 1.93 mm courtyard is deliberately sized so the array placer's courtyard-plus-gap floor (1.93 + 0.6 = 2.53) stays inside the declared 2.54 mm pitch, while 2.54 mm pitch leaves a 0.61 mm courtyard gap between neighbouring pads.
name: prototyping-area

provenance.source: manual; courtyard sized for the 2.54 mm array pitch

watch_out_for: Every pad is deliberately unwired and declared a no-connect: the user wires the field. Do not fit a part here and do not substitute a purchasable test point -- its courtyard is wider than 1.93 mm, which floors the placed pitch above 0.1 inch and breaks the grid the feature exists for.
